usageNote: 日常描述通勤场景！cross a bridge就是过桥，超常见动作短语，讲故事时用它画面感满满！

examples.en: Every morning, students cross a bridge to get to their class on time.
examples.zh: 每天早上，学生们过桥准时赶去上课。

examples.en: She had to cross a bridge to get to her class on time, even in heavy rain.
examples.zh: 即使在大雨中，她也必须过桥才能准时到达教室。
